footer.tagline: The AI Agents IDE for the terminal generation.

hero.subtitle: Sepaito is the AI Agents IDE — multi-terminal, multi-agent, multi-model. Bring your own keys. Run Claude, Codex, Qwen and your MCP agents side by side.

stats.title: Built to run as many agents as you can imagine.

reel.title: Built for the way you actually code.
reel.subtitle: Four reasons builders are switching their day-to-day from Cursor and Claude Code.
reel.step1Body: Run Claude, Codex, Qwen and your own MCP agents side by side. Watch them race.
reel.step2Body: Bring your own API keys; switch providers without leaving the file.
reel.step3Body: 15 curated themes — Claude Darkula, Cursor, Dracula, Gruvbox, Nord, Solarized, and more.
reel.step4Body: A vibe-coding IDE that respects your keyboard, your shell, and your taste.

features.title: Everything you wish your IDE already had.
features.f1Body: Up to 16 parallel panes per workspace. Drag to split.
features.f2Body: Run Claude, Codex, Qwen and your MCP agents side by side.
features.f3Body: Live diff column synced with your working tree.
features.f4Body: Each workspace remembers its agents, prompts, and panes.
features.f5Body: Encrypted local storage. Your keys never touch our servers.
features.f6Body: Claude Darkula, Cursor, Dracula, Gruvbox, Nord, Solarized, more.
features.f7Body: Any MCP-compatible tool works as a pane. No glue code.
features.f8Body: One toggle, off by default. We never log prompts.
features.f9Body: macOS, Windows, Linux. Same workspace, every device.

themesStrip.title: Fifteen curated themes. Pick the vibe.
themesStrip.subtitle: Every theme is a hand-tuned Tailwind palette. Switch from Settings → Themes.

models.title: Claude · GPT · Gemini · Kimi — and your own.
models.body: Bring your own API keys. Add new models from Settings → Models & API. Anthropic Claude Opus / Sonnet / Haiku 4.x · OpenAI GPT-5.x · Google Gemini 3.1 Pro · Moonshot Kimi K2.5.

cta.title: Stop juggling tools.
cta.subtitle: One IDE for every agent you'll ever use.

pricing.title: Simple plans. No seat math.
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you outgrow the limits.

about.subtitle: Most editors treat AI as a sidekick. We treat it as a swarm. Sepaito makes every agent a first-class citizen — with its own pane, its own model, and its own opinion.
about.m1: The IDE is the new shell. It deserves first-class agents, not popups.
about.m2: A workspace should remember the agents that worked in it. Conversation history is part of the codebase.
about.m3: Local first. Always. Your keys, your prompts, your privacy.
about.t1Body: First prototype: a Cursor clone with three terminals running in parallel.
about.t2Body: Multi-model architecture lands. Claude, GPT and a custom MCP agent share one workspace.
about.v1Body: Your code, your prompts and your keys live on your machine. We never get to see any of it.
about.v2Body: No vendor lock-in. Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi — and any MCP server you bring.
about.v3Body: Every flow is reachable from a keystroke. Tab, Cmd+P, and your shell still rule.
